Population increased in Staffordshire

The estimated population of Staffordshire in 2024 was 907,153 usual residents, a rise of 1.0% since 2023.

In the period from mid-2021 to mid-2024, the population estimate of Staffordshire increased by 3.3%.

Age profile of Staffordshire

The average (median) age fell to 44.3 years between 2023 and 2024.

You can see how the age profile of Staffordshire has changed since 2011 in the population pyramid below.

sections.source: Office for National Statistics – Mid-year population estimates

sections.content:
By age category, Staffordshire's population of 907,153 usual residents was made up of:

  • 154,485 people aged 0 to 15 years, (17%)
  • 547,757 people aged 16 to 64 years, (60.4%)
  • 204,911 people aged 65 years and over, (22.6%)

    • Compared with England and Wales as a whole, Staffordshire has a slightly higher proportion of people aged 65 years and over (22.6% compared with 18.9% for England and Wales).

Contributors to population change

We look at different flows of people into and out of areas and births and deaths to see what is driving population change in each area.

In Staffordshire, the largest contribution to population change in the year to mid-2024 was from net internal migration.

sections.title: Contributors to population change in Staffordshire
sections.subtitle: How the population changed, by component

sections.content:
We estimate that, for Staffordshire, between 2023 and 2024:

  • More deaths than births led to a fall in the population of 1,809 people (-0.2%). In total, there were 7,646 births and 9,455 deaths in Staffordshire.
  • Net internal migration (people moving to and from other areas in the UK) increased the population by 8,147 (0.9%). There were 41,535 people entering the area and 33,388 people leaving the area.
  • Net international migration led to an increase in Staffordshire's population of 2,722 (0.3%) as a result of 4,787 people entering the area and 2,065 people leaving the area.
  • Other change (which includes changes to armed forces personnel and prisoners) for Staffordshire was less than 0.1%.

Revisions to 2023 population estimates

We regularly revise our initial population estimates as we get more data and methods improve.

Our revised estimate for the population of Staffordshire in mid-2023 is 897,866.

Within this, international migration was revised upwards by 1,113 people and internal migration estimates were revised downwards by 1,768 people.

Overall, there was an revision downwards of 655 people.
